name: Lattice
author: Erin Carter
description: A neon wireframe grid rushing toward a glowing horizon, a banded sun sitting on the skyline — the classic perspective floor receding to a vanishing point, lines fading into the dark. Bold, retro, kinetic.

params.label: Speed
params.effect: How fast the grid rushes toward you; 0 holds it still.

params.label: Grid density
params.effect: How many grid lines cross the plane; low is bold and wide, high a fine mesh.

params.label: Glow
params.effect: Neon glow on the grid lines and horizon; 0 is flat lines.

params.label: Sun
params.effect: Size and brightness of the banded horizon sun; 0 leaves a bare skyline.

params.label: Mouse influence
params.effect: How strongly the pointer steers the vanishing point; 0 ignores the mouse.
